## Summary

"You can just take noots and stims and be smarter than everyone." — an enumeration tweet mapping the claim-space of cognition pharmacology, one compound per claimed axis (labels are the author's, uncited):

| Compound | Author's claimed effect |
|---|---|
| Modafinil | focus + wakefulness |
| Bromantane | "guilt free dopamine" |
| Dihexa | "insane memory + recovery" |
| Intranasal insulin | flow state + recovery |
| Tropisetron | focus + memory |
| Cerebrolysin | "instant recovery" |
| Agmatine sulfate | brain reset + blood flow |
| Vyvanse | "unmatched drive + focus" |
| Zatolmilast | "photographic memory" |
| Guanfacine | calm focus + working memory |
| DMT analogues | "child-like plasticity" |
| ISRIB | memory + recovery |
| Paraxanthine | "caffeine +++" |

The tweet closes on its own hedge: "This isn't medical advice or a list of things you should randomly take. It's to show you just how many different aspects of cognition modern pharmacology can influence."

## Why it matters

Third data point in RD's active nootropics thread, and the widest-angle one: [[2026-11-10-limitlesstack-modafinil-thesis]] is the deep protocol (modafinil is compound #1 here too, and bromantane recurs in its stack), [[2026-11-10-zygomatic03-pinealon-social-fluidity]] covers the peptide lane, [[2026-11-05-driada-medical-catalog]] is the vendor catalog. Read this one as a checklist of the axes vendors and stack-builders compete on (wakefulness, dopamine tone, memory consolidation, plasticity, recovery) — not as advice.

Skepticism gates: zero citations; 5 likes at capture — this is not a vetted consensus piece; the effect labels are marketing shorthand, not measured outcomes. Dihexa, ISRIB and zatolmilast are research-stage with little or no human cognition data; cerebrolysin is an injectable porcine brain extract; Vyvanse is a prescription amphetamine; "DMT analogues" and others on the list are controlled or prescription-only. In the UAE specifically, modafinil is controlled and most of this list would not be importable — the CoS guidance RD received on this thread 2026-11-10 stands. Reference-only: no task filed, matching RD's stated posture (checking, not ordering).
